locations.title: Barred Door
locations.description: **Unlocked By:** Approaching from the north after the [Assisted Jump](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-5/maps/desperate-escape?locationIds=899631#L)

locations.title: Agitator
locations.description:
Appears in a cutscene here after the [Assisted Jump](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-5/maps/desperate-escape?locationIds=899538#L), but not always - the chances are better if you've killed every enemy in the area first.

It can take a while for the spawns to stop - and if it seems bugged, restarting the game completely can help.

Once he finally *does* spawn, he'll try to run away - quickly run back and kill him for a Score Star (Large).

locations.title: Agitator
locations.description: Atop the wall in front of the two [Grenade Launchers](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-5/maps/desperate-escape?locationIds=899636). You'll need to kill all of the enemies on top of the wall - usually two waves - before the agitator will spawn.

locations.title: Agitator
locations.description:
Emerges from the elevator with around 30 seconds left on the timer, so long as you've been killing the minibosses quickly.

Stay near the elevator and have a proximity bomb or some grenades ready for a quick kill - he'll usually have a parasite grow out of his head, which can be instantly killed with a flash grenade.

locations.title: Transport Area Key
locations.description:
Dropped by an enemy, or spawns in a safe that otherwise holds random loot / a weapon.
- [Safe 1](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-5/maps/desperate-escape?locationIds=899527#L)
- [Safe 2](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-5/maps/desperate-escape?locationIds=899524#L)

**Used To:** Unlock the [Transport Area Door](https://mapgenie.io/resident-evil-5/maps/desperate-escape?locationIds=899529#L)
